name: Singapore Art Museum
scope: The original Singapore Art Museum at 71 Bras Basah Road, the former St Joseph’s Institution, as seen in November 2013. The scope covers the historic main building, curving two-story forecourt wings, domed tower, portico, and connected classroom and chapel masses.

originalReview.notes: The near-street view shows the two-story white entrance, open arched lower arcade, upper paired windows, orange clay roof and round pale tower beneath a gray dome.

review.method: Exact Qualla original with native first-party CC0 dedication
review.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla CC0 photo of the former museum. This dated source predates the closure and later changes at the site.
